name: 32_high_index_reflection_3d
energy_note: Staggered-field proxy; includes PML and is not an exact discrete invariant or calibrated joules.
detector_note: Mean sum of squared staggered electric components; not calibrated Poynting flux or antenna gain.
notes: The specified n=1.5 to n=4 interface only partially reflects. It cannot produce total internal reflection. A separate PEC example supplies the ideal specular mirror. Added z depth is 64 cells, dz=dx, with 12-cell z PML. The x-y geometry, grid spacing and time-step count are preserved. Gaussian beam in both transverse dimensions; x phase delay preserves the original incidence angle.
